pages.text: TYPE_ARRAY stands for the type ARRAY: a list of values.$(br2)An array is numbered from 0. It grows and shrinks by itself. After ARRAY comes the type of its content, like $(1)ARRAY INTEGER$(). Arrays of arrays are allowed, up to 8 levels deep.
Craft a type base and a barrel together.
Assigning to the index right after the end adds a new element.
